primary_sources: AWS DevOps & Infrastructure as Code Best Practices

rules.rule_name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Version Control and Reproducibility
rules.explanation: Configuring cloud infrastructure manually through web consoles (ClickOps) leads to undocumented drift, configuration errors, and non-reproducible environments.
rules.do: Define and provision all cloud infrastructure using declarative Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation) stored in version-controlled repositories.
rules.dont: Do not provision production infrastructure manually via cloud provider web consoles without code representation.

rules.rule_name: Automated CI/CD Pipeline Gates and Quality Checks
rules.explanation: Deploying code updates manually or bypassing automated verification gates introduces syntax bugs and regressions directly into production.
rules.do: Implement automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) that run automated tests, security scans, and code linters before build artifacts are generated.
rules.dont: Do not push code updates directly to production branches or bypass automated testing gates.

rules.explanation: Patching live servers in place during updates creates inconsistent system states and makes failing back to stable versions extremely risky.
rules.do: Adopt immutable infrastructure patterns where servers are replaced rather than modified, paired with automated rollback strategies upon deployment failure.
rules.dont: Do not SSH into production servers to patch packages or modify configuration files live.

rules.rule_name: Centralized Monitoring, Metrics, and Proactive Alerting
rules.explanation: Waiting for users to report system crashes or performance degradation due to a lack of active metric tracking damages system reliability.
rules.do: Configure centralized logging, performance metrics tracking (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), and proactive alerting thresholds for error rates and CPU/memory spikes.
rules.dont: Do not operate production infrastructure without active, automated alerts for critical system failures.
